domain: Video Encoding Configuration and Performance Tracking
scenario:
A multimedia technology company is developing an advanced video encoding and optimization platform for streaming services and content creators. The platform is designed to manage complex video encoding configurations and track performance metrics to optimize the quality and efficiency of video delivery. 

The encoding platform needs to support a wide range of encoding parameters, including CABAC settings, reference frames, deblocking filters, and motion estimation techniques. It should also allow users to define complex configurations for different video content types and adjust settings for bitrate, frame rate, and resolution to achieve the best balance between video quality and streaming performance.

The platform must capture detailed performance metrics such as CPU usage, encoding time, frames processed, and bitrate for each encoding job. These metrics are crucial for analyzing the performance of various encoding configurations and identifying bottlenecks.

Additionally, the system should allow users to compare different encoding configurations, provide recommendations for optimal settings, and allow for the storage and retrieval of configuration profiles for future use. Advanced analytics features are required to help users understand the impact of different settings on video quality and system performance.

The platform should also include a user management system with roles tailored to video engineers, analysts, and administrators to facilitate collaboration and secure access to sensitive encoding configurations and performance data.
